---
title: "Assignment 1: Summary Statistics of Lithic Artifacts (Instructor Solution)"
format: html
---

Instructor solution. The grader runs this file once, caches the objects it
creates, and compares each student's objects against them. Do not hand this
file out. See `docs/conventions.md` for the required object names.

```{r load-data}
artifacts <- read.csv("artifacts.csv")
```

## Task 1: Overall mean and standard deviation of length

```{r overall-stats}
mean_length <- mean(artifacts$length_mm)
sd_length <- sd(artifacts$length_mm)
```

## Task 2: Median length by site

```{r median-by-site}
median_by_site <- artifacts |>
  dplyr::group_by(site) |>
  dplyr::summarise(median_length = median(length_mm), .groups = "drop") |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## Task 3: Count of artifacts by raw material

```{r count-by-material}
count_by_material <- artifacts |>
  dplyr::count(raw_material) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## Task 4: Summary table by site

```{r summary-table}
summary_table <- artifacts |>
  dplyr::group_by(site) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_length = mean(length_mm),
    sd_length = sd(length_mm),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()
```
